title: Check: Reactions of Acids with Carbonates

questions.stem: What are the three products when a carbonate reacts with an acid?
questions.explanation: When a carbonate reacts with an acid, three products are formed: a salt, water, and carbon dioxide gas. The CO₂ is observed as fizzing or effervescence. The general equation is: Metal carbonate + Acid → Salt + Water + CO₂.
